mapper.sql: SELECT r.id, r.segment_id, r.source_type, r.source_id, r.severity, r.description, r.status, r.handle_note, r.found_at, r.resolver, r.resolved_at, r.created_at, s.seg_code AS seg_code, s.seg_name AS seg_name, s.status AS seg_status, CASE r.source_type WHEN 'PATROL' THEN pt.point_code ELSE f.facility_type END AS source_name, CASE r.source_type WHEN 'PATROL' THEN pt.location ELSE CONCAT('设备状态：', f.status) END AS source_detail, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM risk_event c WHERE c.segment_id = r.segment_id AND c.status <> '已解除') AS open_count FROM risk_event r INNER JOIN tunnel_segment s ON s.id = r.segment_id LEFT JOIN patrol_point pt ON r.source_type = 'PATROL' AND pt.id = r.source_id LEFT JOIN facility f ON r.source_type = 'FACILITY' AND f.id = r.source_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO risk_event (segment_id, source_type, source_id, severity, description, status, handle_note, found_at, resolver, resolved_at, created_at) VALUES (#{segmentId}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{severity}, #{description}, #{status}, #{handleNote}, #{foundAt}, #{resolver}, #{resolvedAt}, UTC_TIMESTAMP())
mapper.select: SELECT id, segment_id, source_type, source_id, severity, description, status, handle_note, found_at, resolver, resolved_at, created_at FROM risk_event WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE risk_event SET status = #{toStatus}, handle_note = CASE WHEN #{handleNote} IS NULL OR #{handleNote} = '' THEN handle_note ELSE #{handleNote} END WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{fromStatus}
UPDATE risk_event SET status = '已解除', handle_note = #{handleNote}, resolver = #{resolver}, resolved_at = #{resolvedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = '处理中'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM risk_event WHERE segment_id = #{segmentId} AND status <> '已解除' LOCK IN SHARE MODE

SELECT id, segment_id, source_type, source_id, severity, description, status, handle_note, found_at, resolver, resolved_at, created_at FROM risk_event WHERE segment_id = #{segmentId} AND status <> '已解除' ORDER BY found_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
